title: My Daughter Forged A Dissolution, Sold My $680K Studio, Mailed Me $4,400. So I Voided The Sale
description: After 28 years as a public high school art teacher, I cashed out $127,000 of my pension to open a conservation framing and gilding studio with my daughter, giving her a 45% stake. She forged a dissolution, sold the restored 19th-century gilded frames and client contracts for $680,000, and mailed me a $4,400 check as a payoff, but I found our original partnership agreement hidden inside a hollow bottom rail. Now she gessoes mouldings under Gilt of Deceit Framing while every work order prints her fraud docket number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #GiltOfDeceit
thumb_text: SHE FORGED DISSOLUTION I VOIDED THE $680K SALE
pinned_comment: If your own daughter forged a dissolution and sold your $680,000 studio out from under you, what would you have done with that $4,400 check? Share your story in the comments, I read every one.
